reviewedRevision: 0c85f8e plus the rework in this commit
process: Lean final review at the user's request: the known 5-wave shortfall went straight to a retrofit, followed by one independent review round. Its one MEDIUM finding (thin ammo on sectors 8, 9 and 18) was fixed in level data and verified by re-running the reviewer's own pilot script, one clean-worktree run and the browser check, without a second review round.
independentProbes: The reviewer's own pilot, which reads only public state and must dodge as well as aim, cleared all 22 sectors on 6 seeds at 0.25 s and 0.35 s (132 of 132 each), 174 of 176 at 0.5 s, and won 8 of 8 full campaigns at 0.35 s. After the ammo fix the same script cleared sectors 8 and 9 in 60 of 60 runs at 0.35 s with at most 89% of the ammo used, and sector 18 in 8 of 8 at 0.5 s. Eleven blind patterns (idle, mash, random keys, hold-fire and timed turn-and-thrust sweeps) won at most 1.3% of any sector from 3. Running out of ammo ends the run cleanly instead of soft-locking; fuzz, determinism at 30, 60 and 120 Hz, broken progress stores and EN/ZH text fit all passed.

findings.observation: Only 5 waves built from an if-chain, with no select or continue. There are now 22 data-driven sectors of stone, ice, iron and volatile rocks (teaching 1-9, combination 10-16, mastery 17-22) with accurate EN/ZH lessons, a sector select and env.progress continue; the 854-line file is split into seven modules.

Blind sweeping won most sectors. Shots now travel about 210 px, each sector has a fixed ammo supply that a death does not refill, ship speed is capped at 150 px/s, and a 3 s start shield and 7 s lesson open each sector with rocks spawned clear of the ship, the HUD and the lesson text.
Review finding: the volatile sectors 8 and 9, and sector 18, left a reacting pilot with almost no ammo and occasionally ran out, which ends the run. Those sectors now carry 30% more ammo.

openNotes: Sector 19 (Powder Keg) is the harshest, costing a dodging pilot about one life per run.
Rocks that drift out of the short shot range must be chased with thrust.
When the remaining ammo cannot clear the sector, the game waits for the player to fire it off before ending the run.
Key-press edges are lost only for frames shorter than 1/240 s, which the host's fixed 1/120 s step never produces.

browser.method: Official Claude in Chrome extension, local server; real clicks on Start, Play again, the language switch and the touch buttons, synthetic in-page keys; only DOM text and the canvas were read.
observed: English: Start opened sector 1 of 22 (First Flight) with the lesson below the play area; Left and Space turned the ship and split the rocks (2 to 5 rocks, ammo 40 to 26).
English loss: holding fire spent the rest of the ammo and the run ended with 'Ammunition exhausted'; Play again restarted sector 1 with 40 rounds.
Chinese 390 px phone frame (388 px inner, no horizontal overflow): six touch buttons (左转 右转 推进 射击 刹车 蓄能弹); the Fire button fired a round (ammo 40 to 39).
Not covered in the browser: a sector win and the sector select, which appears only after a first clear; the reviewer's pilot and the quality tests cover both.
